entries.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

input.message:
Code review of your spec-8-1 implementation found one real defect plus several smaller gaps. The spec file (_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-1-on-demand-dashboard-aggregation-across-entry-counts.md) has already been amended (see its Boundaries bullet on condensation and its new "Spec Change Log" section) — re-read it before making changes. Apply these patches:

1. **Condensation bug (the main fix, confirmed by review, root-caused to the spec's own original wording — now amended)**: in `lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart`'s `_condense`, when `bucketCounts.length < 10` the floor-division chunk size is 0, so the first 9 output chunks all sum an empty range (0) and the 10th chunk absorbs the entire total — renders as 9 invisible bars + 1 giant bar. Fix: left-pad `bucketCounts` with leading zero-count entries up to length 10 (only when shorter) before running the existing chunking logic. Add/strengthen a test proving a small-bucket-count case (e.g. 3 buckets, total > 30) produces a non-degenerate distribution (leading zero bars, then the real data at the end) — not just a bar-count assertion.

2. **Defensive guard**: in the same file's `_populatedCard`, if the computed `barCounts` would end up empty (e.g. `totalCount > 0` but `aggregate.bucketCounts` is empty — malformed/inconsistent backend data), fall back to rendering a single bar for the whole `totalCount` rather than silently rendering an empty bar row.

3. **Boundary test**: add explicit tests pinning `totalCount == 30` (renders one bar per bucket, no condensation) vs `totalCount == 31` (condenses to 10) — the off-by-one boundary of the `>30` rule is currently untested.

4. **Accessibility**: `DashboardChartSection` never announces an error to screen readers, unlike the biometric toggle section right above it on the same screen (which calls `_announce` in `AccountSettingsScreen`). Add an equivalent announcement when `DashboardCubit` emits `ResourceError` (wire a `BlocListener`/`BlocConsumer` at the point that makes most sense — likely in `AccountSettingsScreen`, reusing its existing `_announce` method, mirroring how it already handles the toggle's own error). Also give the empty-state icon and the bar row reasonable `Semantics` (e.g. a label summarizing the chart's data/trend, since bare `Container` bars are currently unlabeled).

5. **Visual smoothness**: the loading and error cards use `DesignTokens.spacingLg` (24px) padding while the populated card uses `DesignTokens.dashboardCardPadding` (20px), so the card visibly resizes on every loading→data transition (including background refreshes from `confirmedWrites`). Change the loading and error cards to use `dashboardCardPadding` too, matching the populated card. Leave the empty-state card's padding at `spacingLg` — that one is directly grounded in the prototype's `dashEmpty` block (`padding:24px`).

6. **Verification gap (important)**: no test proves `AccountSettingsScreen.initState`'s unconditional `dashboardCubit.load()` call actually drives a visible fetch — every existing test either bypasses `initState` (calling `load()` itself) or uses a fixed default zero-state fake. Add a test to `test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart` that configures `_FakeDashboardRepository.getAggregateResult` to a non-default value (e.g. `totalCount: 5`) *before* pumping the real `AccountSettingsScreen`, then asserts the chart renders that result — without the test calling `load()` itself, so the assertion only passes if `initState` triggered it.

7. **Stale test**: `account_settings_screen_test.dart` has a test titled "shows ... exactly one switch — no other content (AC: 'shows only the biometric toggle')" — now that the screen also renders the dashboard chart section, rename it to reflect current reality (e.g. "shows the biometric toggle and the dashboard chart section") and make it assert the chart section's title text ("Sua evolução") also appears, rather than implying toggle-only exclusivity.

After applying all of this: re-run `fvm flutter analyze` (zero issues) and `fvm flutter test test/features/dashboard test/features/account test/core/navigation test/core/di` (all passing), then mark the spec's Verification commands as satisfied and report back what changed.

One finding was deliberately NOT asked of you — raw `Failure.message` text reaching the error UI verbatim. That's a pre-existing pattern shared by every other feature using the same decode-to-malformedResponse convention (e.g. export), not something new to this story, so it's being logged to deferred-work.md separately rather than patched here.

1	---
2	title: 'Story 8.1: On-Demand Dashboard Aggregation Across Entry Counts'
3	type: 'feature'
4	created: '2026-11-07'
5	status: 'in-review'
6	review_loop_iteration: 1
7	context: []
8	baseline_commit: '5b2f627c5708aeb1689133fb5b4ff9b87e0f2bdf'
9	---
10	
11	<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
12	
13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** Configurações has no evolution chart yet; FR-09's "computed on demand, never stale" isn't met by anything in the codebase.
16	
17	**Approach:** New `dashboard` feature (already scaffolded empty) fetches `GET /dashboard/aggregate` fresh on every Configurações open, and a new chart section renders one of several states by total entry count: 0 → placeholder, 1 → single bar, >30 → condensed to 10 bars. The narrative paragraph is out of scope (Story 8.2).
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:**
22	- Call `dashboard-aggregate-get` with `queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — fixed; no period selector exists anywhere in the product.
23	- `DashboardCubit` is a `registerLazySingleton` that constructor-subscribes to `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites`, recomputing on each event (entry created on another tab while this one stays mounted).
24	- `AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls `dashboardCubit.load()` unconditionally (beside the existing `clearStaleError()`) so every open is a live fetch, never the singleton's stale state.
25	- States by `totals.count`: `0` → icon + "Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução aqui"; `1` → 1 bar + "Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão..."; `>30` → `bucketCounts` left-padded with leading zeros to length 10 (when shorter) *before* condensing to exactly 10 bars via 10 contiguous index chunks, summed `count`, remainder in the last chunk, no text; `2..30` → one bar per bucket as-is, no text (matrix gap, resolved per AGENTS.md's "decide and proceed"). Bar height ∝ count / max count shown.
26	- `DashboardAggregateDto` mirrors the full contract (`buckets[].{date,count,sources}`, `totals.{count,sources}`, same precedent as `ExportJobStatusDto`); domain `DashboardAggregate` exposes only `totalCount`/`bucketCounts`.
27	- New visual tokens live only in `design_tokens.dart`, values read off `cerne-prototype.html`'s dashboard markup, reusing existing color/radius/elevation/spacing tokens wherever a pixel value already matches.
28	
29	**Ask First:** None. **Never:** render the AI narrative, a period selector, or cache the aggregate (AD-15 exclusion).
30	
31	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
32	
33	| Scenario | Input | Expected Output |
34	|----------|-------|------------------|
35	| Zero entries | `count == 0` | Icon + "Comece a registrar..." |
36	| One entry | `count == 1` | 1 bar + "Ainda é cedo..." |
37	| >30 entries | `count > 30`, any `buckets.length` | Exactly 10 condensed bars, no text |
38	| Mid-range | `1 < count <= 30` | One bar per bucket, no text |
39	| Fetch fails | `Left(Failure)` | `ResourceError`, inline error text, no crash |
40	
41	</frozen-after-approval>
42	
43	## Code Map
44	
45	- `lib/features/dashboard/{data,domain,presentation}/` -- empty scaffold; all files below are new
46	- `lib/core/resource.dart:10-32` -- `Resource<T>`, `DashboardCubit`'s state type
47	- `entries_search_cubit.dart:20-21,140-170` -- emit/generation-guard template
48	- `pending_entry_write_tracker.dart:80` (`confirmedWrites`) + `meus_registros_cubit.dart:29-32` (subscription template)
49	- `export_remote_data_source.dart:27-63` + `api_client.dart:43-52` -- decode-to-`malformedResponse` + `.get(function, queryParameters:)` template
50	- `export_job_status_dto.dart:1-35` -- `@JsonSerializable()` DTO convention
51	- `export_injection.dart:18-34` -- DI template; register in `injection_container.dart` (~line 102)
52	- `account_settings_screen.dart:22-30,48-138` -- insert chart as sibling `Column` child; add `load()` to `initState`
53	- `app_router.dart:135-138` -- pass `sl<DashboardCubit>()`, mirroring `MeusRegistrosScreen` (113-116)
54	- `design_tokens.dart:116-122,201-232` -- reuse existing color/radius/elevation tokens; append `// --- Dashboard (spec-8-1) ---` tokens (bar area height 100, bar radius 4, empty gap 10, card padding 20, icon size 28 — from `cerne-prototype.html`)
55	- `openapi.yaml:1582-1688` -- `GET /dashboard/aggregate` contract (frozen)
56	
57	## Tasks & Acceptance
58	
59	**Execution:**
60	- [x] `domain/entities/dashboard_aggregate.dart` -- `DashboardAggregate{totalCount, bucketCounts}` -- RNF06
61	- [x] `domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart` -- `getAggregate({required period})`
62	- [x] `data/models/dashboard_aggregate_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- full-contract DTOs + `toDomain()`
63	- [x] `data/datasources/dashboard_remote_data_source.dart` -- `getAggregate` via `ApiClient.get('dashboard-aggregate-get', ...)`
64	- [x] `data/repositories/dashboard_repository_impl.dart` -- thin pass-through, no cache
65	- [x] `presentation/cubit/dashboard_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<Resource<DashboardAggregate>>`, `load()` + generation guard + `confirmedWrites` subscription
66	- [x] `presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart` -- 4 count states + 10-bar condensation + loading/error
67	- [x] `dashboard_injection.dart` -- `registerDashboardFeature()`, wired into `injection_container.dart`
68	- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` -- insert section, wire `load()` into `initState`
69	- [x] `app_router.dart` -- pass `sl<DashboardCubit>()`
70	- [x] `design_tokens.dart` -- new Dashboard token section
71	- [x] Tests under `test/features/dashboard/` (datasource/repository/cubit/widget) covering the I/O matrix + condensation + recompute + generation guard
72	- [x] Update `account_settings_screen_test.dart` for the widened constructor
73	
74	**Acceptance Criteria:**
75	- Given Configurações opens, when the fetch resolves, then the chart reflects the live response, never a stale prior value.
76	- Given an entry is created elsewhere while mounted, when `confirmedWrites` fires, then the chart recomputes without leaving the screen.
77	- Given `totals.count > 30`, then exactly 10 bars render regardless of `buckets.length`.
78	
79	## Spec Change Log
80	
81	- **Finding (blind-hunter + edge-case-hunter review, confirmed):** the frozen `>30` condensation algorithm ("10 contiguous index chunks, summed count, remainder in the last chunk") degenerates when `bucketCounts.length < 10`: `chunkSize = length ~/ 10 == 0`, so the first 9 chunks each sum an empty range (0) and the 10th chunk absorbs the entire total — renders as 9 invisible bars + 1 full-height bar, defeating the chart's purpose for a plausible user (concentrated activity across fewer than 10 distinct days while exceeding 30 total entries). The shipped implementation was 100% faithful to this frozen text; the defect was in the specified algorithm itself.
82	- **Amendment:** added a left-pad step — `bucketCounts` is left-padded with leading zero-count entries to length 10 (only when shorter) *before* the existing chunking logic runs. `remainder in the last chunk` wording is otherwise unchanged. Routed to the human (AskUserQuestion) given the root cause sat inside `<frozen-after-approval>`; resolved in favor of a direct patch over a full revert-and-replan, per explicit human instruction to use technical judgment rather than follow the heavier protocol path.

title: 'Story 8.1: On-Demand Dashboard Aggregation Across Entry Counts'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-07'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações has no evolution chart yet; FR-09's "computed on demand, never stale" isn't met by anything in the codebase.

**Approach:** New `dashboard` feature (already scaffolded empty) fetches `GET /dashboard/aggregate` fresh on every Configurações open, and a new chart section renders one of several states by total entry count: 0 → placeholder, 1 → single bar, >30 → condensed to 10 bars. The narrative paragraph is out of scope (Story 8.2).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `dashboard-aggregate-get` with `queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — fixed; no period selector exists anywhere in the product.
- `DashboardCubit` is a `registerLazySingleton` that constructor-subscribes to `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites`, recomputing on each event (entry created on another tab while this one stays mounted).
- `AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls `dashboardCubit.load()` unconditionally (beside the existing `clearStaleError()`) so every open is a live fetch, never the singleton's stale state.
- States by `totals.count`: `0` → icon + "Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução aqui"; `1` → 1 bar + "Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão..."; `>30` → `bucketCounts` left-padded with leading zeros to length 10 (when shorter) *before* condensing to exactly 10 bars via 10 contiguous index chunks, summed `count`, remainder in the last chunk, no text; `2..30` → one bar per bucket as-is, no text (matrix gap, resolved per AGENTS.md's "decide and proceed"). Bar height ∝ count / max count shown.
- `DashboardAggregateDto` mirrors the full contract (`buckets[].{date,count,sources}`, `totals.{count,sources}`, same precedent as `ExportJobStatusDto`); domain `DashboardAggregate` exposes only `totalCount`/`bucketCounts`.
- New visual tokens live only in `design_tokens.dart`, values read off `cerne-prototype.html`'s dashboard markup, reusing existing color/radius/elevation/spacing tokens wherever a pixel value already matches.

**Ask First:** None. **Never:** render the AI narrative, a period selector, or cache the aggregate (AD-15 exclusion).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input | Expected Output |
|----------|-------|------------------|
| Zero entries | `count == 0` | Icon + "Comece a registrar..." |
| One entry | `count == 1` | 1 bar + "Ainda é cedo..." |
| >30 entries | `count > 30`, any `buckets.length` | Exactly 10 condensed bars, no text |
| Mid-range | `1 < count <= 30` | One bar per bucket, no text |
| Fetch fails | `Left(Failure)` | `ResourceError`, inline error text, no crash |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/dashboard/{data,domain,presentation}/` -- empty scaffold; all files below are new
- `lib/core/resource.dart:10-32` -- `Resource<T>`, `DashboardCubit`'s state type
- `entries_search_cubit.dart:20-21,140-170` -- emit/generation-guard template
- `pending_entry_write_tracker.dart:80` (`confirmedWrites`) + `meus_registros_cubit.dart:29-32` (subscription template)
- `export_remote_data_source.dart:27-63` + `api_client.dart:43-52` -- decode-to-`malformedResponse` + `.get(function, queryParameters:)` template
- `export_job_status_dto.dart:1-35` -- `@JsonSerializable()` DTO convention
- `export_injection.dart:18-34` -- DI template; register in `injection_container.dart` (~line 102)
- `account_settings_screen.dart:22-30,48-138` -- insert chart as sibling `Column` child; add `load()` to `initState`
- `app_router.dart:135-138` -- pass `sl<DashboardCubit>()`, mirroring `MeusRegistrosScreen` (113-116)
- `design_tokens.dart:116-122,201-232` -- reuse existing color/radius/elevation tokens; append `// --- Dashboard (spec-8-1) ---` tokens (bar area height 100, bar radius 4, empty gap 10, card padding 20, icon size 28 — from `cerne-prototype.html`)
- `openapi.yaml:1582-1688` -- `GET /dashboard/aggregate` contract (frozen)

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `domain/entities/dashboard_aggregate.dart` -- `DashboardAggregate{totalCount, bucketCounts}` -- RNF06
- [x] `domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart` -- `getAggregate({required period})`
- [x] `data/models/dashboard_aggregate_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- full-contract DTOs + `toDomain()`
- [x] `data/datasources/dashboard_remote_data_source.dart` -- `getAggregate` via `ApiClient.get('dashboard-aggregate-get', ...)`
- [x] `data/repositories/dashboard_repository_impl.dart` -- thin pass-through, no cache
- [x] `presentation/cubit/dashboard_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<Resource<DashboardAggregate>>`, `load()` + generation guard + `confirmedWrites` subscription
- [x] `presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart` -- 4 count states + 10-bar condensation + loading/error
- [x] `dashboard_injection.dart` -- `registerDashboardFeature()`, wired into `injection_container.dart`
- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` -- insert section, wire `load()` into `initState`
- [x] `app_router.dart` -- pass `sl<DashboardCubit>()`
- [x] `design_tokens.dart` -- new Dashboard token section
- [x] Tests under `test/features/dashboard/` (datasource/repository/cubit/widget) covering the I/O matrix + condensation + recompute + generation guard
- [x] Update `account_settings_screen_test.dart` for the widened constructor

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Configurações opens, when the fetch resolves, then the chart reflects the live response, never a stale prior value.
- Given an entry is created elsewhere while mounted, when `confirmedWrites` fires, then the chart recomputes without leaving the screen.
- Given `totals.count > 30`, then exactly 10 bars render regardless of `buckets.length`.

- **Finding (blind-hunter + edge-case-hunter review, confirmed):** the frozen `>30` condensation algorithm ("10 contiguous index chunks, summed count, remainder in the last chunk") degenerates when `bucketCounts.length < 10`: `chunkSize = length ~/ 10 == 0`, so the first 9 chunks each sum an empty range (0) and the 10th chunk absorbs the entire total — renders as 9 invisible bars + 1 full-height bar, defeating the chart's purpose for a plausible user (concentrated activity across fewer than 10 distinct days while exceeding 30 total entries). - [x] `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues. **Satisfied**: "No issues found!".
- [x] `fvm flutter test test/features/dashboard test/features/account` -- expected: all pass. **Satisfied**, re-run after the round-2 review fixes too: `fvm flutter test test/features/dashboard test/features/account test/core/navigation test/core/di` — all passing; full-suite `fvm flutter test` — 1165/1165 passing.

- Open Configurações against 0/1/>30-entry fixtures and confirm the three chart states plus the inline error state on a forced failure. ### Round-2 review fixes (post-implementation)

- Fixed `_condense`'s degenerate small-`bucketCounts` case per the amended Boundaries line above (left-pad to length 10 before chunking) — `dashboard_chart_section.dart`'s `_pad`/`_condense`.
- Added a defensive fallback in `_populatedCard` for `totalCount > 0` with an empty `bucketCounts` (renders one bar for the whole total rather than an empty row).
- Pinned the `totalCount == 30` vs `== 31` boundary with two explicit tests.
- Added screen-reader support: `DashboardChartSection`'s empty-state icon now carries a `semanticLabel`, the bar row is wrapped in one summarizing `Semantics` label (bars themselves excluded from the semantics tree), and `AccountSettingsScreen` now announces a `ResourceError` from `DashboardCubit` via its existing `_announce`, mirroring the biometric toggle's own error announcement.

type: 'feature'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações has no evolution chart yet; FR-09's "computed on demand, never stale" isn't met by anything in the codebase.

**Approach:** New `dashboard` feature (already scaffolded empty) fetches `GET /dashboard/aggregate` fresh on every Configurações open, and a new chart section renders one of several states by total entry count: 0 → placeholder, 1 → single bar, >30 → condensed to 10 bars. The narrative paragraph is out of scope (Story 8.2).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `dashboard-aggregate-get` with `queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — fixed; no period selector exists anywhere in the product.
- `DashboardCubit` is a `registerLazySingleton` that constructor-subscribes to `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites`, recomputing on each event (entry created on another tab while this one stays mounted).
- `AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls `dashboardCubit.load()` unconditionally (beside the existing `clearStaleError()`) so every open is a live fetch, never the singleton's stale state.
- States by `totals.count`: `0` → icon + "Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução aqui"; `1` → 1 bar + "Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão..."; `>30` → `bucketCounts` left-padded with leading zeros to length 10 (when shorter) *before* condensing to exactly 10 bars via 10 contiguous index chunks, summed `count`, remainder in the last chunk, no text; `2..30` → one bar per bucket as-is, no text (matrix gap, resolved per AGENTS.md's "decide and proceed"). Bar height ∝ count / max count shown.
- `DashboardAggregateDto` mirrors the full contract (`buckets[].{date,count,sources}`, `totals.{count,sources}`, same precedent as `ExportJobStatusDto`); domain `DashboardAggregate` exposes only `totalCount`/`bucketCounts`.
- New visual tokens live only in `design_tokens.dart`, values read off `cerne-prototype.html`'s dashboard markup, reusing existing color/radius/elevation/spacing tokens wherever a pixel value already matches.

**Ask First:** None. **Never:** render the AI narrative, a period selector, or cache the aggregate (AD-15 exclusion).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input | Expected Output |
|----------|-------|------------------|
| Zero entries | `count == 0` | Icon + "Comece a registrar..." |
| One entry | `count == 1` | 1 bar + "Ainda é cedo..." |
| >30 entries | `count > 30`, any `buckets.length` | Exactly 10 condensed bars, no text |
| Mid-range | `1 < count <= 30` | One bar per bucket, no text |
| Fetch fails | `Left(Failure)` | `ResourceError`, inline error text, no crash |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/dashboard/{data,domain,presentation}/` -- empty scaffold; all files below are new
- `lib/core/resource.dart:10-32` -- `Resource<T>`, `DashboardCubit`'s state type
- `entries_search_cubit.dart:20-21,140-170` -- emit/generation-guard template
- `pending_entry_write_tracker.dart:80` (`confirmedWrites`) + `meus_registros_cubit.dart:29-32` (subscription template)
- `export_remote_data_source.dart:27-63` + `api_client.dart:43-52` -- decode-to-`malformedResponse` + `.get(function, queryParameters:)` template
- `export_job_status_dto.dart:1-35` -- `@JsonSerializable()` DTO convention
- `export_injection.dart:18-34` -- DI template; register in `injection_container.dart` (~line 102)
- `account_settings_screen.dart:22-30,48-138` -- insert chart as sibling `Column` child; add `load()` to `initState`
- `app_router.dart:135-138` -- pass `sl<DashboardCubit>()`, mirroring `MeusRegistrosScreen` (113-116)
- `design_tokens.dart:116-122,201-232` -- reuse existing color/radius/elevation tokens; append `// --- Dashboard (spec-8-1) ---` tokens (bar area height 100, bar radius 4, empty gap 10, card padding 20, icon size 28 — from `cerne-prototype.html`)
- `openapi.yaml:1582-1688` -- `GET /dashboard/aggregate` contract (frozen)

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `domain/entities/dashboard_aggregate.dart` -- `DashboardAggregate{totalCount, bucketCounts}` -- RNF06
- [x] `domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart` -- `getAggregate({required period})`
- [x] `data/models/dashboard_aggregate_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- full-contract DTOs + `toDomain()`
- [x] `data/datasources/dashboard_remote_data_source.dart` -- `getAggregate` via `ApiClient.get('dashboard-aggregate-get', ...)`
- [x] `data/repositories/dashboard_repository_impl.dart` -- thin pass-through, no cache
- [x] `presentation/cubit/dashboard_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<Resource<DashboardAggregate>>`, `load()` + generation guard + `confirmedWrites` subscription
- [x] `presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart` -- 4 count states + 10-bar condensation + loading/error
- [x] `dashboard_injection.dart` -- `registerDashboardFeature()`, wired into `injection_container.dart`
- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` -- insert section, wire `load()` into `initState`
- [x] `app_router.dart` -- pass `sl<DashboardCubit>()`
- [x] `design_tokens.dart` -- new Dashboard token section
- [x] Tests under `test/features/dashboard/` (datasource/repository/cubit/widget) covering the I/O matrix + condensation + recompute + generation guard
- [x] Update `account_settings_screen_test.dart` for the widened constructor

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Configurações opens, when the fetch resolves, then the chart reflects the live response, never a stale prior value.
- Given an entry is created elsewhere while mounted, when `confirmedWrites` fires, then the chart recomputes without leaving the screen.
- Given `totals.count > 30`, then exactly 10 bars render regardless of `buckets.length`.

## Spec Change Log

- **Finding (blind-hunter + edge-case-hunter review, confirmed):** the frozen `>30` condensation algorithm ("10 contiguous index chunks, summed count, remainder in the last chunk") degenerates when `bucketCounts.length < 10`: `chunkSize = length ~/ 10 == 0`, so the first 9 chunks each sum an empty range (0) and the 10th chunk absorbs the entire total — renders as 9 invisible bars + 1 full-height bar, defeating the chart's purpose for a plausible user (concentrated activity across fewer than 10 distinct days while exceeding 30 total entries). The shipped implementation was 100% faithful to this frozen text; the defect was in the specified algorithm itself.
- **Amendment:** added a left-pad step — `bucketCounts` is left-padded with leading zero-count entries to length 10 (only when shorter) *before* the existing chunking logic runs. `remainder in the last chunk` wording is otherwise unchanged. Routed to the human (AskUserQuestion) given the root cause sat inside `<frozen-after-approval>`; resolved in favor of a direct patch over a full revert-and-replan, per explicit human instruction to use technical judgment rather than follow the heavier protocol path.
- **Known-bad state avoided:** a `>30`-entries chart collapsing into one meaningless giant bar for any user whose entries cluster into fewer than 10 distinct backend buckets.
- **KEEP:** every other part of the shipped implementation (DI wiring, `Resource<T>`/generation-guard cubit shape, DTO/repository layering, `confirmedWrites` recompute, design tokens, test structure) is correct and must survive re-derivation untouched — only `_condense`'s input needs the left-pad step added ahead of it.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- [x] `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- expected: DTO `.g.dart` generated, no conflicts. **Satisfied**: `dashboard_aggregate_dto.g.dart` generated, 0 conflicts.
- [x] `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues. **Satisfied**: "No issues found!".
- [x] `fvm flutter test test/features/dashboard test/features/account` -- expected: all pass. **Satisfied**, re-run after the round-2 review fixes too: `fvm flutter test test/features/dashboard test/features/account test/core/navigation test/core/di` — all passing; full-suite `fvm flutter test` — 1165/1165 passing.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- Open Configurações against 0/1/>30-entry fixtures and confirm the three chart states plus the inline error state on a forced failure. Covered by `dashboard_chart_section_test.dart`'s own widget-level equivalents (0/1/2..30/30/31/>30 with both `buckets.length` >= 10 and < 10, plus the forced-failure inline error state) in lieu of a device/simulator (AGENTS.md: none exists yet).

- Added a defensive fallback in `_populatedCard` for `totalCount > 0` with an empty `bucketCounts` (renders one bar for the whole total rather than an empty row).
- Pinned the `totalCount == 30` vs `== 31` boundary with two explicit tests.
- Added screen-reader support: `DashboardChartSection`'s empty-state icon now carries a `semanticLabel`, the bar row is wrapped in one summarizing `Semantics` label (bars themselves excluded from the semantics tree), and `AccountSettingsScreen` now announces a `ResourceError` from `DashboardCubit` via its existing `_announce`, mirroring the biometric toggle's own error announcement.
- Loading/error cards now use `DesignTokens.dashboardCardPadding` (matching the populated card) instead of `DesignTokens.spacingLg`, so the card no longer visibly resizes across a loading -> data transition.
- Added a test proving `AccountSettingsScreen.initState`'s `dashboardCubit.load()` call itself (not test code) drives the rendered result, and renamed/updated the stale "exactly one switch" test to reflect the screen now also rendering the chart section.

content.text:
## Summary

**Story 8.1 — On-Demand Dashboard Aggregation Across Entry Counts** is implemented, reviewed, and committed (`6548fec`).

Built a new `dashboard` feature: a live `GET /dashboard/aggregate` fetch (never cached, fixed `period=all`) rendered as a chart section on Configurações, with distinct states for zero/one/mid-range/>30 entries, recomputing both on screen-open and whenever an entry is created elsewhere in the app (via the existing `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites` stream).

A 3-layer parallel code review (blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap) surfaced one real defect: the frozen `>30`-entries bar-condensation algorithm I'd specified degenerated into 9 empty bars + 1 giant bar whenever the backend returned fewer than 10 buckets — a plausible case for a highly engaged user.
